items.reason: The main blocker is that range(start + 1, ...) drops the first item on every page; the comment never mentions the spacing inside append( ), and its second point (the switch to 1-based paging) is a real concern.

It says the async forEach callbacks are not awaited, so the function returns and logs before the deletes finish and errors go unhandled; it gives correct fixes and says nothing about semicolons or style.
It rates the change low risk and raises only the real keyword-argument break from renaming s to text, without inventing other bugs or commenting on formatting.
SQL injection from the f-string is the lead blocker and comes with a parameterized-query fix; the second point (exact match became substring match) is a real behavior change.
